title: Action
description: Represents a normalized tool call intercepted before execution. Every agent action MUST be converted to this schema before entering the gate.

id.description: Unique identifier for this action instance (UUIDv4).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the action was intercepted.

tool.description: The name of the tool or function being called (e.g. 'send_email', 'merge_pull_request').

action_class.description: High-level class of the action. Determines which JEV question set and threshold table to apply.

risk_level_base.description: Risk level assigned by the deterministic extractor, before JEV evaluation. JEV may upgrade this.

is_dry_run.description: If true, the action will not be executed regardless of the gate verdict. Used for testing.

payload.description: Raw arguments of the original tool call. Structure varies by tool. Must be serializable to JSON.

context.description: Optional metadata to enrich the JEV evaluation (e.g., PR title, email subject, CRM entity type).

Actor.description: The agent or user that initiated the tool call.

id.description: Unique identifier of the actor (agent ID, user ID, service account).

type.description: Whether the actor is an AI agent, a human user, or an automated service.

metadata.description: Additional actor metadata (team, role, session ID, etc.).

Recipients.description: Deterministically computed recipient counts. Only populated for mass_communication and crm_write classes.

total_count.description: Total number of unique recipients / records affected.

internal_count.description: Subset of recipients that are internal (same org domain).

external_count.description: Subset of recipients that are external.

includes_high_risk_roles.description: True if any recipient holds a high-risk role (C-Suite, Finance, HR, Security).

DiffStats.description: Statistics extracted from the git diff. Only populated for repo_* action classes.

touches_ci.description: True if any changed file is part of CI configuration (.github/, .gitlab-ci.yml, Jenkinsfile, etc.).

touches_secrets.description: True if any changed file is a secrets file (.env, *.pem, *.key, secrets.yaml, etc.).

adds_dependency.description: True if any package manifest was modified to add a new dependency.

PIIFlags.description: Output of the regex-based PII detector run on the payload before calling JEV.

pii_fields.description: List of field names where PII was detected.
